title: LibScript Multi-Backend Cloud TPU Matrix Specification
description: Multi-backend Google Cloud TPU / TFRC isolation, telemetry, and workload matrix specification referenced by experiment suites.

tfrc_policy_path.description: Default relative or absolute path to tfrc.policy.json validated against schemas/tfrc-policy.schema.json.

fresh_vm_per_backend.description: Whether to cycle a fresh Cloud TPU VM between isolated backend evaluations.

require_tpu_hbm_activity.description: Fail-fast assertion requiring observed /dev/accel* or /dev/vfio/* activity and non-zero TPU HBM allocation.

backends.description: Isolated ML framework/backend runtime specifications evaluated across the TPU matrix.

items.description: Single ML backend virtualenv, TPU wheel index, and runtime environment configuration.

keras_backend.description: Optional KERAS_BACKEND value when cli_backend is keras.

tpu_runtime_version.description: Optional TPU VM OS runtime version override.

pip_find_links.description: Optional wheel index URLs passed to uv pip install.

pip_packages.description: Backend-specific Python TPU packages installed into the isolated /dev/shm virtualenv.

env.description: Backend-specific environment variables exported prior to workload runs.

workloads.description: Standardized benchmark and evaluation workloads executed per backend.

items.description: Single workload template and trial repetition specification.

id.description: Unique workload identifier within the TPU matrix.

output_format.description: Serialized output format emitted by the workload.

warmup_runs.description: Untimed warm-up runs before timed trials.

measured_trials.description: Timed steady-state trials recorded after warm-up.
